config.label: Your Garmin Personal API key
config.description: Your Garmin Personal API key. Leave empty if you saved it with `npx -y @durely/garmin-insights-mcp auth` (recommended): the server then reads it from ~/.config/garmin/connect-personal-api-key.

config.label: Your time zone, e
config.description: Your time zone, e.g. Europe/Brussels. Defaults to your computer's time zone.

config.label: The date your key expires, e
config.description: The date your key expires, e.g. 2027-10-24, so the server can warn you in time.
